name: Mushroom Ring (5-6) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-00: The King in Thorns
description: This mushroom ring forms a portal to the First World, allowing the Thorned Monarch's reinforcements into the Material Plane. When the PCs approach, a creature emerges. Creatures continue to emerge until the mushroom ring is disabled. Disabling the mushroom ring also causes any creatures that have emerged to disappear.
disable: DC 21 Thievery (expert) or DC 25 Nature (trained) to rearrange the mushrooms to disrupt the portal (two actions) or Dispel Magic (3rd rank, counteract DC 23) to counteract the magical properties; three successes are required to disable the portal
routine: (1 action) A Korred emerges from the mushroom ring and defends it. All korreds use the mushroom ring's initiative.

generalAbilities.name: Portal
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The PCs approach the mushroom ring

Effect A Korred emerges from the portal to defend it, and the hazard then rolls initiative.
